coach.cardTitle: What would you like to do now?
coach.athleteBody: With a player profile you can join events and appear on the board.
coach.findPeladaBody: Search for a kickabout near you or create yours with +.
coach.nextEventBody: Open the kickabout to see the next event, vote for the best or configure the group.
coach.sumulaBody: You have a referee profile. Open an event in the kickabout to fill in the report.
coach.scoutBody: You have a scout profile. Open the event to record performance.
coach.hint.athleteBody: Fill in positions, measurements and fees. With a profile you can join events and appear on the board.
coach.hint.peladaCreateBody: Give it a name, sport and address. Then create the next event and invite the group.
coach.hint.peladaConfigBody: The admin adjusts details, members, fees and pot collections. Use the tabs on the kickabout page.
coach.hint.eventCreateBody: Set the date, venue and fees. Players register and the admin confirms the PIX payment.
coach.hint.inviteBody: In the menu, use Invite friends to send the app link. In the kickabout, share the event with the group.
coach.hint.teamSplitBody: The admin builds the event teams. Confirmed players appear to be selected.
coach.hint.voteBody: Vote for the best of the event. Highlights rise to the kickabout board and the app board.
coach.hint.sumulaBody: Record the result and incidents. Only the invited referee fills in the report.
coach.hint.scoutBody: Record player performance during the match. The numbers feed the board.
coach.hint.muralBody: Event: this match's highlights. Kickabout: the group's history. App: rankings by neighbourhood, city and county.
coach.hint.legendBody: Register players and teams that marked amateur football. They appear as suggestions on profiles.
coach.hint.payBody: Payment is PIX to the organiser or professional key. Copy the key, pay in your bank and the admin confirms. No Controle de Bola fee.
